arStrings.szText: Attack enemies to fill your Inner Sight gauge. Marked enemies fill it faster. When full, restore {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} Energy, and gain {c_number}[SF_15 * 100|%|]{/c} Energy Cost Reduction, {c_number}[SF_11 * 100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance, and {c_number}[SF_14 * 100|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage for {c_number}{buffduration:BUFF_FREE_CAST}{/c} seconds.
